blockers.description: E2E tests navigating to /vip-program still see login page instead of VIP portal
blockers.cause: Patient authentication fixture not properly setting auth tokens in localStorage

attempts.approach: Checked auth fixture - mockLoginSuccess only mocks API response, doesn't set localStorage
attempts.result: Confirmed the fixture is incomplete - localStorage tokens are not being set before navigation

attempts.approach: Verified app ProtectedRoute checks for auth_token in localStorage
attempts.result: Route protection is working correctly, but fixture isn't setting tokens

blockers.question: Should I modify the patientPage fixture to use loginWithStoredAuth() instead of mockLoginSuccess()? Or is the app supposed to set localStorage when the mocked API returns?
blockers.required_fix: The test fixture (e2e/fixtures/auth.fixture.ts) needs to ensure localStorage auth_token is set before the test navigates to protected routes. Currently mockLoginSuccess() only mocks the API response but doesn't set the token.

concerns: The patientPage fixture (e2e/fixtures/auth.fixture.ts:166-182) is incomplete - it mocks the login API response but doesn't actually set the authentication tokens in localStorage, so subsequent navigation to protected routes fails

The tests expect the full VIP portal to load immediately at /vip-program, but that's a protected route requiring authentication. The fixture setup needs to properly authenticate before the test navigation.
